data.title: 空弦 · 咖啡馆的座位
data.description: 空弦正坐在咖啡馆，带着笑容看向你。
data.promptProse: Sitting at a cozy café table, Archetto leans forward, resting her hands around a steaming porcelain cup. A warm, inviting smile graces her face as she glances toward the viewer, with soft lamplight reflecting in her eyes and the gentle hum of the café in the blurred background.
data.animaCaption: She shares a warm moment over coffee.
